attributes.content:
**EL-BEAM-1.1 Light-mode switch steps through every position**

SCCM_Lighting shall report the light-mode switch on LightStalk.LightMode (0 Off, 1 DaylightRunningLight, 2 LowBeam) so that the value only changes between adjacent positions (Off, DaylightRunningLight, LowBeam), each held for at least one 50 ms cycle.

It shall report the high-beam stalk on LightStalk.HighBeam.

description: Obligation of SCCM_Lighting as LightingRequestSensing in ExteriorLightingDesign (EL-BEAM-1.1).

**Open finding.** The MOZA stalk mappings map the three detents to 0, 1 and 2 and meet this. The Logitech G29 mapping maps one button to 0 and 2, so LightMode jumps between Off and LowBeam: the BCM ignores the jump and the low beam never comes on. It also writes the high-beam button to LightControl.HighBeam, a frame driver_can.dbc does not define.

ImplementedSCCM_Lighting therefore does not meet EL-BEAM-1.1 for the G29, and SatisfactionClaim_NonSafety_ImplementedSCCM_Lighting excludes it. Proposed fix (EL_Beam_Mode_Review.md, option A): map the G29 button as a cycling switch 0, 1, 2, 0 and target LightStalk.HighBeam.
